issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for Lecture.numberOfInscribedStudents and Lecture.numberOfGuestStudents: the problem statement UML in problem_statement.md (lines 64-66) declares these two attributes as double, while the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (lines 7-8) declares them as int. The solution's getTotalNumberOfStudents() method and other logic use int arithmetic and return int, so the UML vs implementation discrepancy will confuse students about whether to implement these attributes and related methods using double or int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md so numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents are declared as int to match the solution implementation and the int return type of getTotalNumberOfStudents(). If fractional student counts were intended, instead change the implementation: make these fields double, adjust getters/setters and calculation methods to use double consistently, and update getTotalNumberOfStudents() return type accordingly.
